name: Wormhole walkthrough (one set of items, four views)
summary: a self-contained presentation page and a set of text-free still plates that show the same twelve items as a layered folder tree, as tag links with an approval gate, as a relationship map and inside six generic system panels, with animated jumps between the views and all wording held in one data block
requires: python3 ≥ 3.9 only to redraw the static plates
retires: the separate filing diagram, connection diagram and systems diagram, and redrawing them for each audience
